item_title: Using translation apps, dubbing software, and VPNs, some Chinese creators are getting millions of views for TikTok videos summarizing Hollywood movies and shows
item_description: Viola Zhou / Rest of World:  — With machine translation, dubbing apps and VPNs, Chinese creators are shortening movies for Americans.

item_title: A look at The Follower, an art project using open-source facial recognition software to match Instagram photos with EarthCam video footage of people taking them
item_description: Kashmir Hill / New York Times:  — A tech-savvy artist unearthed video footage of people working hard to capture the perfect shot for Instagram.
